checks_run.procedure: Review the product diff since round 13 and the full files it touches: session phase (client.ts), RequireSession, LoginPage, Shell sign-out, queries.ts, LanguageSwitch, FE12 render-time translation in the forms; grep scan of added lines. The assignment names the range fe22d759..cbdb4f68, but those are round-10/11 commits (D-070/D-071). The round-13 candidate's source was aa0a68f (round-13 record), so the round-14 product diff is aa0a68f..ea9051b, and that is what I reviewed.
checks_run.command: git diff aa0a68f..ea9051b -- apps packages; git diff --stat aa0a68f..ea9051b -- . ':!docs'; added-line grep scan (diff-scan.log)
checks_run.expected: No weakening of sign-in, sign-out, CSRF, the OIDC returnTo handling or the bilingual error messages; no new XSS sink, CDN, secret or open redirect.
checks_run.actual: 26 files, all under apps/web; no API, database or contract change. returnTo: safeReturnTo (LoginPage.tsx:32) is unchanged, and the API's OIDC login query keeps the same /^\/(?!\/)[^\s\\]*$/ refinement (identity/routes.ts:280). The session-ended redirect builds /login?returnTo=<encodeURIComponent(pathname+search)>, which safeReturnTo validates again. CSRF: endSession and markSignedOut both clear the in-memory token; the server-side Origin and X-CSRF-Token checks are untouched. 403 (forbidden, csrf) and 401 with any code other than `unauthenticated` are not a session end (client.ts isSessionEndedError). Sign-out: logout now uses silent401, then markSignedOut, cancelQueries and clear(); the IdP end-session URL is still the server-provided value. FE11/FE12 only move component state from translated strings to codes translated at render time; output stays React-escaped text, and there is no dangerouslySetInnerHTML anywhere in apps/web/src. The diff scan's 10 hits are CSRF-token clearing, the server-provided endSessionUrl and the encodeURIComponent'd returnTo builders; all are benign. One defect in the new session-end design is reported separately (SEC-R14-20, F-DG2-500).

checks_run.procedure: Web probe W4: an inconsistent server (GET /me 200 but every other GET 401, with an `unauthenticated` problem body and with an empty body), counting requests and navigations over 2 s. API side: the product's own session-end tests bound /me (at most 2 after a landing); the per-IP limiter itself is covered by contract.test.ts (429 RateLimited).
checks_run.expected: No loop: at most 10 requests and 4 navigations in 2 s.
checks_run.actual: Both variants, both Nodes: 4 requests (GET /me, business-units, transformations, GET /me) and 1 navigation in 2 s, ending on /login?returnTo=%2Ftransformations&error=session_expired. No loop: where the round-13 code sent about 130 /me requests per second, this inconsistent server now gets 4 requests. Not retained: an exploratory trace in the probe clone showed that the sign-in page stays put after that last /me 200 until the next /me re-probe (a refocus re-probe then proceeds normally). That is bounded and safe; noted in the narrative, no finding. The log's exit 1 is from W5/W5b only.

checks_run.procedure: Web probes W5/W5b: user A's session ends while the sign-in page is shown in the same document with the phase 'active' (Back to an in-document /login entry). User B then signs in in that tab: W5 with the development form; W5b in OIDC mode, through a /me re-probe after an IdP sign-in in another tab. B's list request is held, so the first render shows whatever the cache holds.
checks_run.environment: Node 22.22.2 and 24.21.0; jsdom; probe clone $TMPDIR/r14p; SYNTHETIC users A and B
checks_run.expected: B never sees A's cached rows (TR-A-SECRET); the session end clears the session-scoped cache whatever page is shown.
checks_run.actual: FAIL on both Nodes, in both W5 and W5b. After A's end on /login the phase is 'ended', 1 transformations query is still cached, and B's first render of /transformations shows 'Synthetic User B' together with A's row TR-A-SECRET. Cause: only <RequireSession> clears the cache (session.tsx:52-58), and the sign-in page lies outside it, so a 401 on its /me ends the session without a claim; the next /me 200 makes the phase 'active' again. Control: when the session ends under <RequireSession> (W6, and the product's session-end.test.tsx) nothing leaks. New finding F-DG2-500 (Medium, not mandatory: server-side authorisation is intact, the data is what A already held in that tab, and the production preconditions are narrow).

checks_run.procedure: Web probe W6: after a session-end landing (a /me re-probe answers 401), press the browser Back button 3 times.
checks_run.expected: The signed-in shell is never rendered and requests stay bounded (12 or fewer).
checks_run.actual: Shell never seen (false, false, false). 1 request across 3 Back presses, final /login, on both Nodes. The dry-run version of W6 failed because it navigated to a page that issued no request (fresh /me), so no 401 ever happened. That was a probe error, corrected to re-probe /me. The log's exit 1 is from W5/W5b only.

summary: PASS with one new Medium finding that is not a mandatory violation (F-DG2-500). The FE10 session-end rule does what F-DG2-480 needed: the loop is gone (4 requests and 1 navigation against even an inconsistent server, where round 13 sent about 130 /me per second), 403 and CSRF refusals never end a session, returnTo stays same-origin, and no stale shell appears. It has one gap: a session that ends while the sign-in page is shown is never claimed, so the session-scoped cache survives into the next sign-in in that tab (F-DG2-500). Every required check ran and passed: typecheck, build, lint, openapi:lint, no-cdn, format, unit tests on Node 22 and 24 and under load (848/848), integration in both locales (612/612 each), AUD-403 146/146, and the round-12/13 API probes. No API regression.
